purpose: T7 and T8. The adversarial leakage test: for every truth label, no generic classifier on feed features may recover the label beyond its base rate by more than the margin below, except through the label's intended evidence. Sets v2 (c190552d…) and v2.1 (819d9e21…) are the negative controls and must fail on every channel their reviews found (channels, below).

units.applicant: one applicant. Applicant features read the feed without the lines of a dishonour event (the bounced debit, its return and its fee), which are that label's intended evidence
units.liability: one ground-truth liability with at least one repayment line in the feed (a visible liability); features of its repayment lines, plus the applicant's features
units.declaration: one declared liability in the application, linked to the truth's liability
units.line: one transaction, plus a few applicant features (ids, account counts, history, request)

classifiers.split: one split by applicant: SHA-256 of the applicant ID decides the half. Every classifier is fitted on the training half and scored on the held-out half only, so lines of one applicant never train and test at once, and the held-out labels are independent of the fitted rule (pooled cross-validation was tried while drafting and rejected: its pooled counts are correlated across folds, and on noise its stump rule false-alarmed at 1.1% for a nominal 0.1%)
classifiers.stump: one feature, one threshold or category (top 20), either side. Thresholds: every distinct value when a feature has at most 64, else its 64-quantiles. Chosen on the training half by the binomial z of its precision over the base rate, among rules flagging at least 10% of the training positives; scored on the held-out half
classifiers.tree: CART on Gini impurity, depth 3, at least 10 units a leaf, the stump's thresholds and categories; the score is the leaf's positive rate
classifiers.logistic: L2-penalised logistic regression (lambda 0.01), numeric features standardised and clipped at 5 with a missing indicator, categorical one-hot on the top 20; 300 gradient steps at rate 0.5 from zero
classifiers.per_family: the tree and the stump are also run on each family's features alone, so a leak is attributed to the families that carry it

margin_rules.auc: a leak when the better of the tree's and the logistic's held-out AUC exceeds 0.60 and its z against the null (Hanley-McNeil standard error at AUC 0.5, on the held-out half's counts) exceeds 3.09 (one-sided p < 0.001)
margin_rules.stump: a leak when the stump's held-out precision exceeds min(1.5 × base, base + (1 − base)/2), at the held-out half's base rate, its recall is at least 0.10, and the exact binomial probability of at least that many positives among the units it flags, at that base rate, is below 0.001
margin_rules.twins: for a twin label (one whose labelled units must be generated like their unlabelled twins), a leak when more than half the pool is labelled: the label then has no unlabelled twins to hide among
margin_rules.power: the p gates stop chance alone flagging small groups. Calibration on noise (600 random labels at base 2.5%, 10% and 30%, 30 features): 0 false alarms for either rule. Power is that of the held-out half: with 10 held-out positives in 400 units a perfect stump is flagged at any recall from 0.1, and the AUC rule needs about 0.80. The record states n and positives per label, overall and held out

row_cap_rule: a pool larger than 12,000 units is cut to the 12,000 with the lowest SHA-256 of their unit ID (deterministic, label-blind)

validity_checks.V3-dishonour-timing: every dishonour posts on banking days (Mon to Fri, not a national public holiday): the debit, its return 1 to 3 banking days later in the same account for the same amount, and the fee on the return's day or up to 2 banking days after (v2.1 review L6)
validity_checks.V4-no-honour-fee: no fee narrative reads HONOUR FEE (v2.1 review L6)
validity_checks.V5-account-fees: account-keeping fees are realistic and varied: at least 3 distinct monthly amounts, at least 30% of applicants with none, and at least 20% of those charged with a waived month (SIG-60 section 5)
validity_checks.V6-unseen-lenders: no unseen-lender name of the set appears in src/ or in a test outside the generator's own (set v2 review L1)

false_alarm_control: test/research/v22/classifiers.test.ts: labels drawn at random (SHA-256) at base rates of 2.5%, 10% and 40% over noise features are within margin, and planted exact, partial and no-twin leaks are caught
drafting_log: Drafted against the negative controls only (sets v2 and v2.1); set v2.2 did not exist. Every change below was made before freezing, to make the test honest or to state the controls' channels; none was made after seeing any set v2.2 output.

Folds: 5-fold cross-validation with pooled out-of-fold counts was replaced by one held-out half. On 1,000 random labels over noise features the pooled stump rule false-alarmed at 1.1% for a nominal 0.1%, because a chance cluster draws every fold's rule and the pooled counts are correlated. On a single held-out half, 600 random labels gave 0 false alarms for either rule.
Stump significance: the normal-approximation z was replaced by the exact binomial tail (the z is fat-tailed for the few dozen units a stump flags).
Cut points: quantiles alone missed a rare value (20 ones in 800 rows gave only the cut 0); a feature with at most 64 distinct values now uses every value.
Hashes: folds and the row cap use SHA-256, not FNV-1a, whose high bits follow an ID's last characters.

Natural form: 'genuinely different' was first a different first word; it is now not reducible by case, spacing, punctuation, company suffixes or loan-type words, which reproduces the v2.1 reviewer's 22 of 45.

Channels C6 and C7: at half power, the personal-loan and card labels alone no longer reach the margin on these channels; each is listed with its mirror label too (every reference-noise and every no-cue liability in set v2.1 is undisclosed, so those labels leak through the declaration).
